en: The image shows an old black-and-white photograph of a stone bridge embedded in a rocky and forested landscape. Several people are visible standing on the bridge and pathway, some wearing traditional or old-fashioned clothing. The caption at the bottom reads: 'Graz. Schloßberg. Partie v. neuen Schloßbergsteg.' There is also a publisher logo indicating 'Knoll Müller Verlag Graz.' The overall look suggests an early-to-mid 20th-century European postcard.
